name: agentstack
description: Work Graph control plane for ChatGPT and Codex. Bound project: agents.work_next (recipe mcp_work_loop_v1) via agentstack.execute; catalog search is fallback. Also projects, auth, hosted sites, and storage. This plugin does not sell plans or digital goods in chat.

interface.longDescription:
AgentStack's control plane is the Work Graph. Authorize first: call auth.get_profile before discovery, project reads, or Work Graph actions. If unauthorized, ask the user to Connect with OAuth; do not silently create an anonymous project. After authorization and project binding, call agents.work_next (recipe mcp_work_loop_v1) before catalog search. Catalog search is the fallback.

The server advertises one tool, agentstack.execute. Action names and parameters come from the live catalog on that server. Confirm with the user before a delete or any other irreversible change.

This plugin does not sell plans, credits, or digital goods in ChatGPT or Codex. It uses the account you already connected. It does not start checkout or a new subscription.
defaultPrompt: What is the next Work Graph step on this project?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or start subscriptions in ChatGPT or Codex.

publication.release_notes: Remote MCP at https://agentstack.tech/mcp over Streamable HTTP with OAuth dynamic client registration. The same package is the connector for ChatGPT, Codex, and other Agent Plugins hosts. There is no local stdio server. Custom GPT Actions schema remains in openapi/.
